mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% for three consecutive months signals severe labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances when UNRATE > 9.5 for 3 months, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate revenue expectations deteriorate.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in >55% of cases over 3-year window, or interaction term p-value >0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 3.0%) increase equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as valuation pressures mount.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production growth (INDPRO > 100.5) signals robust corporate output and profit expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >55% of periods when INDPRO > 100.5, or Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 550.0 thousand units indicate weakening residential demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as consumer confidence erodes.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in >45% of instances when HOUST < 550.0, or Rank IC < 0.02 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll growth (PAYEMS > 130000.0) and unemployment decline (UNRATE < 10.0) signal strong labor market dynamics, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint PAYEMS growth and UNRATE decline fails to predict positive returns in >55% of cases over 3-year window, or interaction term p-value >0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP level below 12900.0 billion dollars signals economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as recession risks elevate.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in >55% of periods when GDPC1 < 12900.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
